name: io.github.modern-ai-inc/ai-recommendation-rate-mcp
title: Modern AI Brand Recommendation Rate
description: How often AI search picks a brand first. Recommendation Rate data from Modern Discovery.

tools.name: lookup_brand_recommendation_rate
tools.description: Look up a brand's AI Recommendation Rate: the percentage of buyer-intent questions where AI search picks the brand first, not just mentions it. Also returns its Recommendation Inclusion Rate: how often the brand appears anywhere in the answer. Measured on ChatGPT with search enabled, refreshed monthly. Use it to check a brand's generative engine optimization (GEO) or AI search visibility, or how visible a brand is when AI answers recommend products. Returns the brand's public record URL and measured date for citation, plus its company profile (each fact with its source link) when one is published. Free, one brand per call, rate-limited per Modern AI's published anti-scrape policy.

brand.description: Brand name to look up, e.g. "Brumate"

tools.name: get_recommendation_rate_methodology
tools.description: Definitions of Recommendation Rate and Recommendation Inclusion Rate, the metrics Modern Discovery uses to measure brand recommendation in AI answers. States the AI surface measured (ChatGPT with search enabled) and the monthly refresh cadence. Use it to explain how GEO or AI search visibility is measured before quoting a number. Links to the full methodology page.
